tmp:2547: kavod she-mekhabed yirei Hashem — the act of honoring God-fearers, by which the exiled glory (kavod) returns to its root in yirah (fear)
tmp:2548: 'ad she-tikhleh regel min ha-shuk' — the halakhic time limit for lighting Chanukah lamps ('until foot traffic ceases from the marketplace'), read as the cessation of commerce that betokens universal peace
tmp:2550: de-nashkei ar'a u-reki'a — the spot 'where earth and heaven kiss' in Rabbah bar bar Chanah's tale, symbolizing peace within one's own bones/self
tmp:2552: shalom ha-klali as shleimut ha-olamot — the universal peace defined as the perfection/completion of all the worlds, attained through prayer-as-korban (drawing the worlds near to wholeness)
tmp:2553: shilum sakhar — requital/payment of reward (here, punishment-recompense to the wicked in the World to Come), linked to the letter Heh via 'hegeh va-hi' (Eruvin 21)
tmp:2554: shulchan shebi-kdushah — the holy table, a symbol of Malkhut/kingship whose blemish (via lust for eating) lets the brazen-faced seize honor
tmp:2556: 'yakiru ve-yed'u kol yoshvei tevel' — the Aleinu phrase 'all inhabitants of the world will recognize and know,' signifying the perfection of da'at (knowledge of God)
tmp:2557: 'yokhal teref' — 'he devours prey' (Benjamin the wolf, Gen 49:27), signifying the completed altar built 'in the portion of the tearer' (Toref) in Benjamin's territory
tmp:2558: shleimut ha-simchah — the perfection/completion of joy, achieved through yirah (fear = 'nishma'/prayer), which grounds holy boldness (azut di-kdushah)
tmp:2559: le-karev davka ha-meruchakim — the action of drawing near specifically the distant ones (even idolaters) to Israel's faith, per Zephaniah 3:9
tmp:2560: shleimut ve-kishutei emunah — the completeness and adornments of faith (emunah), consisting precisely in bringing the far-off close to God
tmp:2561: shleimut la-mochin — completeness/wholeness of the mochin (mental faculties), i.e., pure holy thought needed to sweeten judgments on Rosh HaShanah
tmp:2562: shlosh-esreh middot — the Thirteen Attributes of Mercy God arranged wrapped in a tallit (RH 17b), identified as the holy ruach-chaim (spirit of life)
tmp:2563: eilu ha-shloshah sikhliyim — the three intellectual faculties of Torah wisdom, each containing Chokhmah-Binah (Yud-Heh), together numerically 'Adam' (45)
tmp:2564: shalosh pe'amim Y-H — three times the divine name Yud-Heh (15×3=45), the gematria of 'adam,' encoding Chokhmah-Binah within each of the three intellects
tmp:2565: shalosh klipot ha-nal — the three impure husks (kelipot) constituting the orlah (foreskin), the root-source of disgrace removed by circumcision
tmp:2566: 'teshuvat ha-shanah' — the phrase 'the return/turn of the year' (II Sam 11:1), read as the season of the three festivals, days of judgment and repentance
tmp:2567: shalosh regalim — the three pilgrimage festivals (Pesach, Shavuot, Sukkot) as days of judgment/teshuvah when the exiled Malkhut is brought out
tmp:2568: gildana — the sea-fish in Rav Ashi's Talmudic tale, whose letters encode the divine name AGLA ('Atah Gibor Le'olam Adonai'), an aspect of gevurot
tmp:2569: meshaber et libo — breaking one's heart/spirit within oneself in shame over one's fall, the inner act constituting a burnt-offering (olah)
tmp:2571: nesirah — the kabbalistic 'sawing apart' of the back-to-back configuration (as with Adam) enabling face-to-face union, effected via the name Chata"kh
tmp:2573: shem YB"K — the divine name Yud-Bet-Kuf (gematria 112), whose letters spell 'baki' (expert), underlying the twofold expertise 'baki be-ratzo, baki be-shov'
tmp:2574: shefa gashmiyut — material/physical abundance, identified with the 'left' side of Torah ('in her left hand riches and honor')
tmp:2575: Korach — the Levite rebel against Aaron, archetype of the left (smola) opposing the right, root-pattern of all machloket (strife)
tmp:2576: smola — the kabbalistic 'left' side (vs. yemina/right), the polarity whose inclusion into the right via hand-clapping nullifies strife
tmp:2577: smolah — 'her left' (of Torah, Prov 3:16), the left-side aspect into which the Tanna slipped by a hairsbreadth error while teaching
tmp:2579: shmirat ha-brit via mezuzah — guarding the covenant through the mezuzah scroll, which nullifies coveting/lust for money ('lo tachmod' ↔ 'u-khtavtam al mezuzot')
tmp:2580: she-nikhlalim yachad kol ha-nefashot — the merging/inclusion of all souls (each a 'candle') together into one light, generating joy ('or tzaddikim yismach')
tmp:2581: min ha-mitzvot — the commandments as the primary source of joy ('pikudei Hashem... mesamchei lev'), the joy that lights up the face
tmp:2582: na'aseh ve-nishma as Torah u-tefillah — the Sinai declaration 'we will do and we will hear' identified as the pair Torah ('do') and prayer ('hear')
tmp:2583: nirsham ha-kol ba-lev — the voice's imprint inscribed on the heart (tevel = tav-lev, 'mark on the heart,' Ezek 9:4), the thunder that straightens the heart
tmp:2584: simchah gedolah ve-nitchadshu ha-mochin — the state of great joy that renews one's mochin (mental faculties), arising from knowing one's lack is in the Shekhinah
tmp:2585: hasarat akmumiyut she-ba-lev — removing the crookedness of the heart to attain yishrut lev (uprightness of heart), the precondition for joy ('u-le-yishrei lev simchah')
tmp:2586: simchatan shel Yisrael — 'the joy of Israel,' an epithet of the heart/Shekhinah whose exile is the exile of Israel's joy
tmp:2587: 'yoshev ohalim' — Jacob's epithet 'dweller in tents' (Gen 25:27), read as the aspect of heaven ('He stretched them out like a tent to dwell in,' Isa 40:22)
tmp:2588: shemi'ah — hearing, the faculty by which the heart is aroused: the forceful voice strikes the brain (galgalta de-mocha) producing thunder that awakens the heart
tmp:2589: yotzei mi-shrirut ha-lev u-meshaber lev ha-even — exiting the heart's stubbornness and shattering the heart of stone, i.e., leaving imagination for intellect
tmp:2590: shamir — the legendary stone-cutting worm/agent (used for the Temple stones), symbolizing what subdues the stone heart so one follows intellect over imagination
tmp:2592: shmirat tzitzit — the guarding afforded by the tzitzit fringes over the eyes, protecting from the serpent's counsel and from adultery ('lo taturu... acharei eineikhem')
tmp:2593: simlah as tzitzit — the garment Shem and Yefet laid over Noah (Gen 9:23), read in Tikkunei Zohar as tzitzit, the covering that shields from sexual sin
